title: 第七章 沧澜双华凝域同契第八章 幻域低语幽弥之影
slug: 星冕天启守护者觉醒录
lines: 夏风穿林，拂过琉光星冕综合学园成片连绵的香樟树冠，层层叠叠的碧叶翻涌起伏，筛落满校园细碎流动的金色暖阳。
方才结束的课间喧嚣余温未散，悠长沉稳的上课铃声准时响彻整片学园空域，澄澈清亮的铃音穿透每一栋教学楼的廊道，抚平了少年少女嬉闹的笑语，让躁动的校园再度归于规整静谧。
阳光坦荡，晴空万里，澄澈的天际干净得没有一丝流云，暖融融的天光温柔笼罩着整座培育英才的菁菁校园。在外人眼中，这里依旧是安宁祥和、岁月静好的求学圣地，晨间那场短暂的暗影风波早已彻底落幕，所有凶险与阴霾尽数消散，只余下日复一日的安稳日常。
可只有身处棋局核心的宿命守护者们清楚知晓，这份触目可及的平和，从来都只是暴风雨来临前的短暂假象。
暗处的暗流从未停歇，蛰伏的杀机从未消散，暗樱女王布下的猎杀棋局，自清晨双生本源松动的那一刻起，便已然步步落子、层层收紧，只待最佳时机，给予致命一击。
高中部，高二（1）班教室。
规整明亮的教室内鸦雀无声，粉笔轻触黑板的细碎声响清脆入耳，任课老师的授课声平稳温和，缓缓流淌在整洁的空间之中。全班学子端坐课桌之前，目光专注落于讲台之上，沉浸在书本知识的世界里，神色安然，无忧无虑。
靠窗最僻静的一隅，天野凛星身姿挺拔端正，脊背笔直如松，端坐于课桌前，姿态规整合规，完美贴合着品学兼优、沉稳自律的优等生模样。
他目光平视前方的黑板，视线看似专注认真，稳稳定格在板书字迹之上，丝毫没有走神异动。可无人知晓，他眼底深处，从未有一刻真正放下戒备，周身极致敏锐的感知力早已尽数铺展，化作一张细密无边、覆盖整座学园的灵力感知大网，牢牢锁定着学园每一寸土地的气息波动。
自课间时分与藤咲若织隐秘商议完守护布局，一明一暗、一守全局一护一隅的双重守护模式便已悄然开启，无声运转，未曾间断。
他清晰捕捉到，课间短短数十分钟里，初中部空域先后涌现七次细碎零散的暗影波动，每一缕黑暗气息都阴柔隐晦、极具隐蔽性，没有磅礴暴戾的破坏力，却带着精准针对心神与本源的侵蚀之力，每一次出现，都精准缠绕在初二（3）班的方位，死死纠缠着海月涟音与琉璃金朵两位少女。
七次暗影侵扰，七次无声消散。
每一次黑暗气息刚刚成型、即将侵蚀双生本源的瞬间，便会被一股温柔却坚韧、兼具草木生机与红莲焚邪之力的光明灵力瞬间瓦解、彻底净化。
无需亲眼所见，无需刻意探查，天野凛星心中已然了然。
是藤咲若织。
那位始终隐匿在人群之中、温柔淡然的学生会会长，正以无人察觉的姿态，游走在初中部的每一处阴影角落，默默消解着所有细碎的暗影试探，为尚未觉醒、毫无自保能力的双生继承者，隔绝了所有无声的凶险侵扰。
她的守护隐忍而坚定，沉默却有力，不张扬、不显露、不求任何人知晓，只以一己之力，默默撑起了初中部最脆弱的防线，挡住了暗樱女王抛出的第一波试探利刃。
这份默契无需言语印证，无需契约绑定，是属于宿命守护者之间，最深刻、最心安的共鸣与信赖。
天野凛星眸光微沉，眼底掠过一丝审慎凝重。
藤咲若织化解的，终究只是暗樱势力派出的零散傀儡、最低阶的试探手段。这些微不足道的暗处袭扰，从来都不是敌人的真正杀招，仅仅只是用来磨损双生本源、加速封印破碎、试探光明防线反应速度的诱饵罢了。
暗樱女王心思缜密阴鸷、杀伐狠绝，筹谋三年隐忍蓄力，绝不会满足于这般不痛不痒的暗中试探。
她在等。
等待海月涟音与琉璃金朵体内的双生封印彻底松动、本源灵力彻底躁动紊乱、身心状态濒临最脆弱的临界点。
等待两位无记忆、无战力、无经验的双生继承者，彻底暴露所有破绽，沦为毫无反抗之力的待捕猎物。
等到时机成熟，便是狂风骤雨、雷霆落杀的终极围剿。
而这一刻，已然临近。
持续数轮的暗影气息侵蚀刺激，早已打破了两位少女体内本源灵力的平衡，层层叠加的千年封印，裂痕密布、岌岌可危，濒临彻底破碎的边缘。
天野凛星指尖轻搭在课本页面之上，指尖微凉，心绪沉稳如磐，心底的戒备却已然攀升至顶点。
他作为守护者战队的队长，执掌冰与圣光双重力量，拥有极致瞬身突袭能力与全域掌控力，早已做好随时奔赴战场、正面破局、誓死护人的万全准备。
只要暗影主力敢现身围剿，他便会第一时间冲破桎梏、奔赴初中部，以寒冰封邪、以圣光净化、以利刃破局，挡在两位懵懂少女身前，斩断所有黑暗杀机。
与此同时，高二（1）班教室正中的课桌位置，藤咲若织端坐于此，身姿温婉挺拔，气质恬淡安然，全然是一副认真听课、潜心求学的乖巧模样。
浅红柔赤渐变的规整校服衬得她眉眼温柔澄澈，红调渐变的柔顺长卷发安静垂落肩头，发尾淡淡的赤焰光泽在窗边洒落的暖阳下若隐若现，柔和得让人无法与杀伐凌厉的守护者挂钩。
她目光平和落于讲台之上，神色淡然无波，看似全心投入课堂学习，实则周身细密的草木灵力与红莲净火早已无声蔓延，化作轻薄透明的灵力屏障，层层笼罩整片初中部教学楼，三百六十度无死角监控着每一缕气息异动。
她比天野凛星更加清晰地感知到双生少女的状态变化。
每一次暗影傀儡的侵扰，都会让海月涟音、琉璃金朵体内同源共生的水风、土金本源躁动加剧一分，封印裂痕扩大一分，沉睡的神域记忆碎片活跃一分。
短短课间十几分钟，两次少女的灵力紊乱程度，已然远超过去数日的总和。
原本微弱零散、转瞬即逝的记忆碎片，此刻已然变得清晰连贯、鲜活立体。原本只是轻微酸胀、心神不宁的身体异样，此刻已然化作连绵不绝的灵力翻涌、经脉震颤。
双生本源的共鸣共振，越来越强烈、越来越炽热、越来越不受控制。
封印破碎、血脉觉醒、记忆回笼，所有宿命既定的蜕变，都在黑暗的步步紧逼之下，被迫加速推进，提前降临。
藤咲若织的眼底藏着一层无人察觉的冷冽凝重。
她太清楚暗樱女王的险恶用心。
敌方从不打算给双生继承者平稳觉醒、循序渐进掌控力量的机会，只想以连绵不绝的黑暗压迫，逼迫两人在灵力失控、心神紊乱、毫无引导的绝境之中仓促觉醒，再顺势出手掠夺纯净无双的双生本源，彻底斩断沧澜神域最后的血脉传承，瓦解人间光明防线的核心根基。
content_en:
The summer wind blows through the forest, blowing through the continuous canopy of camphor trees in Liuguang Xingmian Comprehensive Academy. The layers of green leaves are undulating, and the golden warm sunshine is filtering through the campus.
The hustle and bustle of the recess that had just ended was still lingering, and the long and steady bell rang on time throughout the entire campus. The clear and clear bell penetrated the corridors of every teaching building, calming the playful laughter of young girls and making the restless campus orderly and quiet again.
The sun is bright, the sky is clear, and the sky is so clear that there is not a single cloud. The warm sky gently envelopes the entire elite campus that cultivates talents. In the eyes of outsiders, this place is still a peaceful and peaceful place for study. The brief shadow storm in the morning has completely ended, and all dangers and haze have dissipated, leaving only the stable daily life day after day.
But only the guardians of destiny who are at the core of the chess game know clearly that this palpable peace is always just a short-lived illusion before the storm comes.
The undercurrent in the darkness has never stopped, and the dormant murderous intention has never dissipated. The hunting chess game laid out by the Queen of Dark Sakura has been tightening step by step since the moment the twin origins were loosened in the early morning, waiting for the best opportunity to deliver a fatal blow.
High School, Class 1, Grade 2 Classroom.
There was silence in the neat and bright classroom. The sound of chalk touching the blackboard was clear and crisp. The teacher's teaching voice was steady and gentle, flowing slowly in the tidy space. Before the whole class sat at their desks, their eyes were focused on the podium, immersed in the world of book knowledge, with calm and carefree expressions.
In the most secluded corner by the window, Amano Rinxei's posture is upright and upright, with his back as straight as a pine tree. He sits in front of the desk with a regular posture, which perfectly fits the appearance of a top student who is excellent in both morals and academics, calm and self-disciplined.
He looked straight at the blackboard in front of him. His gaze seemed focused and serious, fixed firmly on the writing on the blackboard, without any movement. But no one knew that deep in his eyes, he had never really let down his guard for a moment. The extremely keen perception around him had already been spread out, turning into a fine and boundless spiritual perception network covering the entire school, firmly locking the aura fluctuations of every inch of the school.
Since secretly discussing the guardianship layout with Fujisaki Wakaori during recess, the dual guardianship mode of one light and one dark, one guarding the overall situation and the other guarding a corner, has been quietly activated, running silently and without interruption.
He clearly captured that in just a few dozen minutes between classes, seven scattered shadow fluctuations appeared in the airspace of the junior high school. Each dark breath was soft and subtle, extremely concealed. It did not have the majestic and violent destructive power, but it carried corrosive power that accurately targeted the mind and origin. Every time it appeared, it was precisely entangled in the direction of Class 3 of the second grade of junior high school, entangled with the two girls Haiyue Lianyin and Liuli Jinduo.
Shadows invaded seven times and disappeared silently seven times.
Every time the dark breath has just taken shape and is about to erode the origin of the twins, it will be instantly disintegrated and completely purified by a gentle but tough light spiritual power that combines the vitality of vegetation with the evil-burning power of the red lotus.
No need to see it with your own eyes, no need to deliberately explore, Amano Rinxing already knows it in his heart.
It's Fujisaki Wakaori.
The gentle and indifferent President of the Student Union, who is always hidden among the crowd, is walking in every shadow corner of the junior high school without anyone noticing, silently dispelling all the subtle shadow temptations, and isolating all silent and dangerous intrusions for the twin successors who have not yet awakened and have no ability to protect themselves.
Her protection was forbearing and firm, silent but powerful. She was unobtrusive, unshowy, and did not ask anyone to know. With her own strength, she silently supported the most vulnerable line of defense in the junior high school and blocked the first wave of probing blades thrown by the Queen of Dark Sakura.
This tacit understanding does not need to be confirmed by words or bound by contract. It is the deepest and most reassuring resonance and trust between the guardians of fate.
Amano Rinxing's eyes darkened slightly, and there was a hint of caution and solemnity in his eyes.
What Fujisaki Wakaori resolved was, after all, just scattered puppets and the lowest-level probing methods sent by the Dark Sakura forces. These trivial harassments from the dark are never the enemy's real killer move, they are just bait used to wear down the twin origins, accelerate the breaking of the seal, and test the reaction speed of the light defense line.
The Queen of Dark Sakura is meticulous, sinister, and ruthless in killing. She has been planning for three years to endure and accumulate strength. She will never be satisfied with such a painless secret test.
She is waiting.
Waiting for the twin seals in Haiyue Lianyin and Liuli Jinduo to be completely loosened, the original spiritual power to be completely restless and chaotic, and the physical and mental state to be on the verge of the most fragile critical point.
Waiting for the two twin successors with no memory, no combat power, and no experience to completely expose all their flaws and become prey without the power to resist.
When the time comes, it will be the ultimate encirclement and suppression with violent winds, rain, and thunder.
And this moment is already approaching.
Several rounds of continuous erosion and stimulation by the shadow aura have already broken the balance of the original spiritual power in the bodies of the two girls. The thousand-year-old seals stacked on top of each other are filled with cracks and are in danger, and are on the verge of being completely broken.
Amano Rinxei's fingertips rested lightly on the textbook page. His fingertips were slightly cold, and his mind was as calm as a rock, but the vigilance in his heart had already reached its peak.
As the captain of the Guardian team, he controls the dual power of ice and holy light. He possesses the ultimate ability to instantly attack and control the whole area. He is fully prepared to rush to the battlefield at any time, break the situation head-on, and protect people to the death.
As long as the main force of the shadows dares to show up to encircle and suppress them, he will immediately break through the shackles and rush to the junior high school. He will use ice to seal the evil, use holy light to purify, and use sharp blades to break the situation. He will stand in front of the two ignorant girls and cut off all the dark murderous intentions.
At the same time, at the desk in the middle of the classroom of Class 1, Grade 2, Fujisaki Wakaori was sitting there, with a gentle and upright posture, a calm and calm temperament, and he looked like he was listening to the class carefully and studying with concentration.
The regular school uniform with a gradient of light red and soft red made her eyes gentle and clear. Her long curly hair with a gradual red gradient fell quietly on her shoulders. The faint red flame luster at the end of her hair was looming under the warm sun shining by the window. It was so soft that one could not associate it with the murderous guardian.
Her eyes fell calmly on the podium, her expression calm and calm, and she seemed to be devoted to class study, but in fact, the dense spiritual power of the vegetation and the red lotus pure fire around her had spread silently, turning into a light and transparent spiritual barrier, covering the entire junior high school teaching building layer by layer, monitoring every breath movement from 360 degrees without blind spots.
She sensed the changes in the twin girls' status more clearly than Amano Rinkei.
Every intrusion of the shadow puppets will intensify the restlessness of the symbiotic water, wind, earth and metal in Haiyue Lianyin and Liuli Jinduo's bodies, widen the cracks in the seal, and activate the sleeping memory fragments of the divine domain.
In just ten minutes between classes, the girl's spiritual disorder was far greater than the previous few days combined.
The memory fragments that were originally weak, scattered, and fleeting have now become clear, coherent, and vivid. What was originally just a slight soreness and restlessness in his body has now turned into a continuous surge of spiritual power and trembling in his meridians.
The resonance of twin origins is getting stronger, more intense, and more and more out of control.
The seals were broken, the bloodline was awakened, and the memories were restored. All the fateful transformations were forced to accelerate and come ahead of schedule under the pressure of darkness.
There was a layer of coldness and solemnity hidden in Fujisaki Wakaori's eyes that no one noticed.
She was very aware of Queen Dark Sakura's sinister intentions.
The enemy never intends to give the twin successors a chance to awaken smoothly and gradually control their power. They only want to use the continuous oppression of darkness to force the two to awaken hastily in a desperate situation where their spiritual power is out of control, their minds are chaotic, and there is no guidance. Then they will take advantage of the situation to plunder the pure and unparalleled twin origins, completely cutting off the last blood inheritance of Canglan Divine Realm, and disintegrating the core foundation of the human world's light defense line.
title_en: Chapter 7: Canglan Twin Flowers Condensing Realm and Sharing the Same Agreement Chapter 8: The Phantom Realm Whispers the Shadow of Youmi
